reviews.author: Jackie Flow
reviews.text: Amazing tow service! Great communication! Everyone was booked solid and they were the only ones who told me straight up that they couldn’t come and get it that night but they would the next day and they did! Highly recommend!

reviews.author: Chef Smyrl
reviews.text: Did an awesome job, it was a small space and he put it in that space perfectly the first time! If I ever need another tax service it'll be you!

reviews.author: Kasual Fanning
reviews.text: Ultimate towing is the best around and the best prices around you would not regret choosing them.very respectful staff

reviews.author: Penny Smyrl
reviews.text: Did an awesome job! It was a small space and he put it in it perfectly the first time! If I ever need another tow service I will definitely be using you!

reviews.author: Vincent Ruby
reviews.text: They are very nice people!!! They have knowledge and are experts at their craft!!! Plus, they weren’t trying to find stuff they could up charge me for. The price for their work was refreshing. The guy from a different company who came out to give us an estimate, charged us $350.00 and didn’t even open his tool box.

reviews.author: Trent Kincaid
reviews.text: This company was super professional and nice. It was like you are a part of their family and they were doing you a favor. It was a big change from most that are rude from the start. If you need towing, please call these guys as they are the best!! Thanks to everyone at Ultimate Towing for your help!!!!

reviews.author: bsukem bsukem
reviews.text: Absolutely the best Tow truck service ever especially the fact they were open on Christmas Eve to help me when I got stranded on the side of the road because my transmission left me sitting. I will definitely be recommending them to everybody I know. And best part of it all they’re extremely reasonable with their rates.

reviews.author: Natalie Sharpe
reviews.text: Ultimate Towing has a very quick response time and I highly recommend. They got to me in under 30 minutes and delivered my car safely to the shop!

reviews.author: Gavin
reviews.text: If you need a tow these folks will help you out with prompt safe service and great rates! My mustang gt broke down in Bull swamp they came out and towed my vehicle all the way home over 70 miles! There drivers are safe and there equipment Is awesome. dont hesitate call today!

reviews.author: Ken Hoffman
reviews.text: We had a blowout on 1-26 and they responded quickly and towed us to a tire store before they closed. The two young men on the truck were very well mannered and knowledgable. I would ise thus company if i ever had the need to do so anywhere in their service area.

reviews.author: S'zavier House
reviews.text: Absolutely horrible service, wife and daughter broke down with flat tire near midnight. Gentlemen shows up in what appears to be their personal vehicle without a jack and without anyway to remove our tire and install the spare tire. What roadside assistance company can’t change a tire out. Then to top it off the gentlemen tells my wife he has to return to the shop for a second time to find a different jack after attempting to lift the car while both were seated inside… and guess what he calls the insurance company and cancels the service stating that they could not change the tire but fails to call my wife and inform her she is waiting for absolutely nothing. If this place could receive negative stats they would receive it and I will be inspecting my vehicle to ensure you caused no damage when attempting to lift it improperly before scurrying off. Absolutely ridiculous

reviews.author: Whitney Roberts
reviews.text: If you ever need a tow near or far this is the place to do it. Communication was great! The price was fair! Ultimate Towing is the way to go! Guys we are living in a world full of scammers. It's good to know that you can still trust some people these days! Thank you again Carly!!!

reviews.author: Carlisa Bedenbaugh
reviews.text: We had a flat yesterday. Our insurance company sent out Ultimate Towing. Who then dispatched one of their drivers to come and change our tire (we didnt have a jack on the truck). He showed up in his personal vehicle. Once the tire was changed, we noticed noise in the front end, only made it roughly 1/8 of a mile from where we had assistance. We called Schroders towing and paid $250 to have our truck towed to our preferred shop. When we arrived at the shop, the mechanic noticed that 5 out of 8 of our lug nuts were not even tightened. When we called the office to inform them, they showed no remorse and told us "i dont know what you want me to do, insurance only pays us $75 for these services".... They get undershot and underpaid by insurance, so they do sloppy work and show no remorse over the fact they failed to tighten lug nuts properly which couldve killed someone. CALL SCHRODERS, NOT ULTIMATE TOWING.

reviews.author: D Moon
reviews.text: Thank y'all Ultimate Towing for putting our family at ease and picking up our F250 and 29 foot camper off the side of Hwy 378! Y'all will forever be who we recommend to others and request for ourselves. Every obstacle we faced, y'all were willing to help with a solution! God bless y'all.

reviews.author: Genessis Cardenas
reviews.text: Great towing company! Honest and reliable. Carley the dispatcher was so nice, and always communicated where the tow truck was. I needed a ride on the tow truck and they provided it. The truck was clean and the customer service amazing!

reviews.author: Denaro Ponds
reviews.text: They were quick in picking my car and I up and driving us from Orangeburg to Columbia, at an affordable price! If you’re reading this, definetly choose this company! They are simply amazing! Thank you all again for helping me. God bless you all!

reviews.author: Juan Rivera
reviews.text: Had some issues with my truck last night… they were very understanding and helpful… without them I’d still be on the side of the road… nice people and I wouldn’t hesitate to call if I need them again .

reviews.author: Deirdre Hairston
reviews.text: I believe there is room for improvement in the communication process at this establishment. The notification processes could be more efficient to ensure customers are kept informed about the status of their vehicle. Additionally, pricing may be higher than expected, which is something to consider when utilizing their services.

reviews.author: Tonia Stone
reviews.text: ALWAYS GREAT SERVICE! I USE ULTIMATE TOWING ON A REGULAR BASIS. THEY WORK WITH YOU TO ACCOMIDATE YOUR SCHEDULE AND TIME CONSTRAINTS. FAIR TOWING PRICES AND THEY KEEP YOU INFORMED IN THE PROCESS, WHICH IS PRICELESS! HIGHLY RECOMMEND FOR ALL YOUR TOWING NEEDS!!

reviews.author: It's Me
reviews.text: Easy to contact. They Kept me up to date and they were very honest about any questions I asked. This is a young couple trying to establish great business. Guys you have me as a value customer here in out.

reviews.author: Sonya Hairston
reviews.text: Where is it acceptable to handle *business* in an unprofessional manner? This business has no customer service skills. We are pursuing any & all things legal to correct your inappropriate business tactics! Where is it written or when did you state during the phone call that you would charge to come open the gate on a Saturday? Why would a towing company NOT be open on a Saturday?? UNACCEPTABLE on every level... and you will reap what you sow!

reviews.author: Elizabeth Weddington
reviews.text: Ultimate Towing was responsive, professional and very expedient when it came to their response time and service. I would recommend their company to anyone!

reviews.author: Kristie Marshall
reviews.text: Very unprofessional, they are unrealistic with their charges, this business needs to be shut down. No business should take a persons car and charge them out of this world for something that is theirs and feel good about it! Never heard of any business like this!

reviews.author: Samantha Johnson
reviews.text: Ultimate Towing is the best. Fast, courteous and professional service. The driver Greg was so professional and I would recommend them to everyone!! Thank you ultimate Towing!!

reviews.author: Juli P
reviews.text: Very fast!!! Thank you so very much for rescuing me & getting me & my car home safe! 10/10 totally recommend!!!!

reviews.author: Cole Wolcott
reviews.text: Needed a last minute tow on Memorial Day and these guys came through in the clutch. Customer service was top notch from dispatcher to the truck driver.

reviews.author: Brittany Grindstaff
reviews.text: Great company and amazing prices family friendly and they’re there at a drop of a dime!! Keep up the good work yall!!

reviews.author: Ramel Martin
reviews.text: When all else failed, these guys came Thur, everyone was closed took care of me and got me rolling in less than an hour. Amazing service!!

reviews.author: Tyler Family
reviews.text: Very professional service and got the job done in adequate timing! Will definitely be using them again if another situation occur.

reviews.author: Regime II (Regime)
reviews.text: Helped my father tow his motorcycle during nighttime, highly recommend this towing company, thank you!

reviews.author: tony mckinney
reviews.text: They where excellent to deal with. They communicated with me and arrived when they said they would. Friendly service

reviews.author: Jami Gripper
reviews.text: Worst company! DO NOT do business with them. Rude customer service and unreliable! The lady was nasty and rude!
